summary: This proposal is developed in response to the requirements. Given that an astronaut cannot rely on outdated information—but rather needs the most current data—we propose sending a new rover. How does this differ from the rovers already on Mars? This small robot, which we suggest be deployed via a lander, would perform environmental mapping and digitization, transmitting data in real time. It would feature a system that continuously updates the information displayed on the astronauts' tablets.
details: As we described earlier, the idea of ​​developing a project based solely on old images—without accounting for current conditions—is highly impractical. While it was possible to get the concept off the ground, real human lives are at stake here; therefore, we need the ability to provide solutions—ideally within a matter of minutes—which is the purpose of the interface, even though this particular demo is primarily for educational purposes.
